हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: It’s Showdown Time, I’m the Global Billionaire’s Daughter is a high-stakes drama about a woman who discovers her true identity as the heir to a global empire. Thrown into a world of power struggles, envy, and love, she must fight to claim her place and protect everything that’s hers.
